records.issue_text: In handleNewBooking.ts, evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars) silently no-ops when evt.destinationCalendar is null, dropping team members' destination calendars for collective events where the organizer has no personal destination calendar
records.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, evt.destinationCalendar is set to null when neither eventType.destinationCalendar nor organizerUser.destinationCalendar exists (`... : null,`). Later, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which will no-op when destinationCalendar is null, so team members' destination calendars are dropped in that case.
